function: Excluded (system): UAV-enabled over-the-air asynchronous FL, an area 7 work with scalar device-to-UAV channels and scalar transceiver factors (single antennas) and no RIS (pp. 3-4).
notes: System: the paper never mentions antennas. Single antennas follow from p. 3, eq. (7), the scalar channel h_m(k) with one phase theta_m(k), and p. 4: "b_m(k) in R is amplitude of beta_m(k)" and "a denoising factor zeta(k) in R". y(k) spans C channel uses, not antennas, and there is no RIS. Area 7: gradients aggregated by over-the-air computation (p. 4), with trajectory, device selection and transceiver optimized by GP/SCA (pp. 6-8). The NTN exemption was not applied because the PS is a UAV but no learned method controls the aerial link; the reviewer should confirm this. Earlier codes do not apply: the FL model is learned, and transceiver design is PHY. MNIST simulations are on pp. 8-11. The PDF is arXiv:2403.06653v1 and has the same title and authors as the DOI.
